name: MsoSmartArtNodePosition
description: Specifies constants that define the different ways to add a new node to the data model in SmartArt.

constants.name: msoSmartArtNodeDefault
constants.description: The default. Corresponds to clicking Add Shape in the SmartArt ribbon.

constants.name: msoSmartArtNodeAfter
constants.description: Insert a node after the SmartArt node in the data model. Corresponds to clicking Add Shape After in the SmartArt ribbon.

constants.name: msoSmartArtNodeBefore
constants.description: Insert a node before the SmartArt node in the data model.

constants.name: msoSmartArtNodeAbove
constants.description: Insert a node above the SmartArt node in the data model.

constants.name: msoSmartArtNodeBelow
constants.description: Insert a node below the SmartArt node in the data model.
